items.english: Except that when I popped out they decided at the last minute that they really wanted a girl.
items.chinese: 只不過當我呱呱墜地時，他們在最後一刻決定他們真正想要的是個女孩。

items.english: So my parents, who were on a waiting list,
items.chinese: 所以我的養父母，當時正在候補名單上，

items.english: got a call in the middle of the night asking: 'We have an unexpected baby boy; do you want him?'
items.chinese: 在半夜接到了一通電話問道：『我們有一個意外出生的男嬰，你們要他嗎？』

items.english: My biological mother later found out that my mother had never graduated from college
items.chinese: 我的生母後來發現，我的養母從未從大學畢業，

items.english: and that my father had never graduated from high school.
items.chinese: 而我的養父連高中都沒畢業。

items.english: She refused to sign the final adoption papers.
items.chinese: 她拒絕在最終的收養文件上簽字。

items.english: She only relented a few months later when my parents promised that I would someday go to college.
items.chinese: 幾個月後，直到我的養父母承諾有一天一定會送我上大學，她才妥協。

items.english: And 17 years later I did go to college.
items.chinese: 而 17 年後，我也真的上了大學。

items.english: But I naively chose a college that was almost as expensive as Stanford,
items.chinese: 但我很天真地選擇了一所學費幾乎和史丹佛一樣貴的大學，

items.english: and all of my working-class parents' savings were being spent on my college tuition.
items.chinese: 我那藍領階級父母所有的積蓄，都花在了我的大學學費上。

key_words.meaning: 藍領階級的；勞工階級的

items.english: After six months, I couldn't see the value in it.
items.chinese: 六個月後，我看不出這一切有什麼價值。
